metaDescription: Professional Jaguar engine replacement services - removal, supply & fit, ECU coding, and full road-test validation. Fixed-price quotes from our Essex workshop.
lede: Complete engine removal, supply, and fit for all Jaguar models - from X-Type to F-Type, XJ to F-Pace. Fixed-price work with full warranty.

blocks.html: Our Jaguar engine replacement service covers the complete mechanical and electronic integration of a replacement engine into your vehicle. The process is methodical and uses JLR-specific diagnostic equipment to ensure the new engine is correctly matched and coded to your car.

items: Full pre-diagnostic scan and ECU backup
Front-end disassembly (bumper, radiator, intercooler, subframe as needed)
Detachment of all ancillaries, wiring, and exhaust components
Engine removal using professional hoist and support equipment
Transfer of reusable components to the replacement unit
Reinstallation and reconnection of all systems
JLR-specific ECU coding, VIN matching, and immobiliser synchronisation

blocks.html: Our engine replacement service covers the full Jaguar range - from classic XJ to the latest F-Pace. Every replacement is matched to your exact vehicle specification.
Key variant examples we regularly replace:

steps.title: Pre-diagnostic & backup
steps.body: We run a full JLR diagnostic scan, clear faults, and back up the current ECU settings to ensure a clean baseline.

steps.title: Disassembly
steps.body: Front bumper, radiator, intercooler, and often the front subframe are removed to access the engine bay.

steps.title: Detach ancillaries
steps.body: All electrical connectors, exhaust bolts, coolant hoses, and engine mounts are systematically disconnected.

steps.title: Engine removal
steps.body: Using a professional engine hoist (322 kg+ capacity), the old unit is lifted out - or the subframe is lowered as one assembly.

steps.title: Component transfer
steps.body: All reusable sensors, manifolds, and brackets are transferred to the replacement engine.

steps.title: Reinstallation
steps.body: The replacement engine is fitted, aligned, and all connections are re-made with factory torque settings.

steps.title: ECU coding & synchronisation
steps.body: Using JLR SDD / Pathfinder, we code the ECU to match the new engine's parameters and your vehicle's VIN. Immobiliser synchronisation is also performed.

steps.title: Validation & road test
steps.body: Every replacement undergoes a full road-test to confirm all systems operate correctly before handover.

items.q: What's included in an engine replacement?
items.a: Our service includes removal of the old engine, supply of a correctly matched replacement unit, fitting, transfer of all reusable ancillaries, JLR ECU coding and immobiliser synchronisation, and a full road-test validation. We also include a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

items.q: How long does a Jaguar engine replacement take?
items.a: Typical workshop time is between 14 and 30 hours depending on the model and engine type. We'll give you a clear schedule when we quote - most replacements are completed within one working week.

items.q: Will the replacement engine be coded to my car?
items.a: Yes - we always perform dealer-level ECU coding to match the new engine's parameters to your vehicle's VIN. This ensures correct operation and full integration with the immobiliser, transmission, and other modules.

items.q: Do you source the replacement engine, or do I supply it?
items.a: We supply the replacement unit for you - we source engines from reputable suppliers and ensure they are the exact match for your vehicle. We never fit customer-supplied engines because we can't guarantee their condition or compatibility.

items.q: Can you recover my Jaguar if it's not driveable?
items.a: Absolutely - we offer nationwide engine recovery starting from £70. Just call us and we'll arrange collection to our workshop.
